title: RUSSELL PETERS
tickerText:
** TOURING NOW !!!**   RUSSELL PETERS IS A CANADIAN STAND-UP COMEDY SUPERSTAR, BORN IN TORONTO AND RAISED IN BRAMPTON, ONTARIO. FAMOUS FOR HIS LIGHTNING-FAST CROWD WORK, SHARP CULTURAL OBSERVATIONS, PLAYFUL ACCENTS AND FEARLESS IMPROVISATION, HE TURNS EVERY AUDIENCE INTO PART OF THE SHOW.
